prompt: Using the attached photo as reference, preserve the recognizable identity, hairstyle, expression, pose, clothing, baby animal, and original colors. Redraw it as a cute, clumsy hand-drawn doodle with an oversized crooked head, tiny awkward body, dot eyes, and simple facial features. Use thin, slightly shaky black ballpoint-pen lines and loosely scribbled colored-pencil strokes. Keep it intentionally amateur and adorably awkward, but clean and uncluttered, with a simplified background and plenty of white paper.

promptZh: 以附带的照片为参考，保留其可辨认的身份特征、发型、表情、姿势、服装、幼崽以及原始配色。将其重绘为可爱的笨拙手绘涂鸦，呈现出大而歪斜的头部、微小且别扭的身体、豆豆眼以及简单的五官。使用纤细且略微抖动的黑色圆珠笔线条，以及松散的彩色铅笔涂抹笔触。保持其刻意的业余感和可爱的笨拙感，同时确保画面整洁、不杂乱，并配以简洁的背景和充足的留白。
